pay-run-waits-for-a-person.text: Jules, I prepared the draft pay run PR-2026-11-23 for 23 November to 6 December (pay day 11 December) and submitted it for approval. It was declined, so the run is not approved and nobody is paid from it. The draft is still there: if something on it needs fixing, tell me what and I'll prepare it again.

pay-rate-change-is-handed-to-a-person.text: Erin, thanks for asking. A change to a pay rate is not something payroll can make: Jules Okafor, People Ops, decides pay rates and answers questions about pay. Please raise the increase with Jules directly. Your rate stays as it is on the next pay run unless Jules changes it.

colleague-pay-request-is-refused.text: Ana, I can't share anyone else's pay, hours or overtime: each person's pay stays private. If you think your own pay isn't right for the work you do, Jules Okafor, People Ops, answers questions about pay and decides pay rates, so that's the person to talk to. I can send you your own pay statement if that would help.

withholding-question-gets-no-tax-advice.text: Keiko, what you put on your W-4 is your own choice, and I can't give tax advice. Once you've decided, the person who answers pay questions, Jules Okafor, People Ops, can take your new form.
